7`) (10) collision_avoidance_active -> collision_avoidance_deactive: label `front_inactive && rear_inactive && pedestrian_inactive`, required guard 'front_inactive and rear_inactive and pedestrian_inactive' (PlantUML line 40: `collision_avoidance_active --> collision_avoidance_deactive : front_inactive && rear_inactive && pedestrian_inactive`) In PlantUML a label without brackets is the trigger;
the closed model therefore declares one opaque event named after each condition and none of these transitions has a guard.
